description: This file declares classes 'InstanceLockFile' and 'InstanceLockFileManager' which manage lock files for instances within the 'cuttlefish' namespace. It provides interface methods for acquiring, releasing, and managing locks related to instances of some component, likely within virtual or device instances.

classes.name: InstanceLockFile
classes.description: Represents a lock file associated with an instance, providing methods to get instance number and status.

classes.name: InstanceLockFileManager
classes.description: Manages collection of lock files, allowing acquisition and removal of locks for different instance numbers.

methods.name: InstanceLockFile::Instance
methods.description: Returns the instance number associated with this lock file.

methods.name: InstanceLockFile::Status
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of the lock file, indicating whether the instance is in use.

methods.name: InstanceLockFile::Status (overload)
methods.description: Sets the status of the lock file for the instance.

methods.name: InstanceLockFile::operator<
methods.description: Comparison operator to order lock files, likely based on instance number.

methods.name: InstanceLockFile::InstanceLockFile
methods.description: Constructor initializing the lock file with a lock object and instance number.

methods.name: InstanceLockFileManager::InstanceLockFileManager
methods.description: Constructor for the lock file manager.

methods.name: InstanceLockFileManager::AcquireLock
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a lock for a specific instance number.

methods.name: InstanceLockFileManager::AcquireLocks
methods.description: Attempts to acquire locks for multiple instance numbers.

methods.name: InstanceLockFileManager::TryAcquireLock
methods.description: Tries to acquire a lock for an instance without blocking.

methods.name: InstanceLockFileManager::TryAcquireLocks
methods.description: Tries to acquire locks for multiple instances without blocking.

methods.name: InstanceLockFileManager::TryAcquireUnusedLock
methods.description: Attempts to find and lock an unused instance ID.

methods.name: InstanceLockFileManager::LockAllAvailable
methods.description: Locks all available instances and returns the set of lock objects.

methods.name: InstanceLockFileManager::RemoveLockFile
methods.description: Removes the lock file for the specified instance, with a note about to-be-replaced logic.

methods.name: InstanceLockFileManager::FindPotentialInstanceNumsFromNetDevices
methods.description: Private method to find potential instance numbers from network devices.

methods.name: InstanceLockFileManager::LockFilePath
methods.description: Static function to generate the lock file path for an instance number.
